title: Task Manager shows disk I/O only for one worker on Windows with `num_workers>0
bug_description: ### 🐛 Describe the bug Hi, I was training on a Windows machine with `num_workers > 0` and found in the task manager that only one worker has disk I/O. So i inserted this block to `collate_fn` and saw multiple workers working. ``` pid = os.getpid() wid = torch.utils.data.get_worker_info().id print(f"[PID={pid}/WID={wid}]") ``` Is this a bug in task manager, or is there more to it? ### Versions Collecting environment information...
